notes.title: Synstasis Update v1.3
notes.content: Updated Street Level for a more transparent direction to reach Doba's Bar when leaving the Tunnel. An additional model was added to the end cut scene for scene continuity.

notes.title: Added Additional Floor Highlight.
notes.content:
Added additional floor highlight ring to help make Doba's Bar Entrance stand out even more from the Street.

Enjoy!
Reckless Games Studio
Steven M.

notes.title: Synstasis Soft Update v1.1
notes.content:
Synstasis Demo has been given a update that exposes the "Invert Vertical Mouse Input" option in the Menus for users who desire Inverted Y look control Scheme. Be sure to Press "Apply" Button in the Lower Left Corner of Menu after making any changes.

Enjoy!
